text:
maria: quick sync — I'm thinking we need a compact dashboard for microbatching signals that ties together batch formation, queue policies, and token/sec so we can diagnose regressions faster.

jon: +1. what surface do people need? per-model vs global?

eva: per-model is critical for us. also per-instance group (dedicated pools) — different kernel selection behavior shows up there.

sam: high-level: batch_utilization, queue_depth, tokens_per_sec, avg_batch_size, tail_latency (p95/p99), kv_cache_hit_rate, and idle_gpu_pct.

dena: can we also add 'pending_tokens' i.e., queued tokens waiting to be scheduled? that's been useful for token budget tuning.

maria: yes — pending_tokens + budget_target_exhaustion flag. we should expose a short list of failing queue policy reasons (e.g., "timeout", "budget_exceeded", "kv_block").

batch-bot: new event: microbatch_policy_eval completed for pool=dedicated-g4, window=60s, regressions=0

jon: prototype panel idea: heatmap of avg_batch_size by model x hour, and histogram of batch formation latency. makes regressions pop.

sam: sample PromQL for batch_utilization (per model label):
```
sum(rate(batch_tokens_served_total{model=~".*"}[1m]))
/ sum(rate(request_token_capacity_total{model=~".*"}[1m]))
```
we need to be careful: token capacity depends on kernel choice and concurrency. tag metrics with kernel= and quant= labels.

eva: for queue depth: use gauge `microbatch_queue_depth{pool,model,priority}` and show both current and 5m avg. alert if queue_depth > X and tokens_per_sec < Y (indicates stall).

dena: alert idea: when p99 latency increases >2x and batch_utilization drops >25% simultaneously => page oncall. those two together often mean bad kernel selection or KV cache thrash.

maria: agree. Also need an eval panel that overlays profiling samples (cpu/gpu kernels) for the same window — so SRE can correlate long tails to kernel fallbacks.

sam: on instrumentation: push microbatch event with fields: model, pool, kernel_selected, batch_size, formed_after_ms, tokens_in_batch, kv_hit_fraction, reason_for_not_adding (if any).

jon: small snippet for event proto we've used before: `MicrobatchEvent { string model; string pool; string kernel; int32 batch_size; int32 tokens; float kv_hit; string drop_reason; }`. store to metrics and event-store (for traces).

maria: UX: default dashboard should be 6 tiles: overview sparkline (tokens/sec), avg_batch_size, batch_utilization, queue_depth, kv_cache_hit_rate, and tail_latency. drilldown links to traces/profiling.

eva: add a toggle to normalize by model sequence length distribution (samples per model). otherwise models with short prompts look better.

dena: for regression detection: run nightly baseline and compute expected batch_utilization by model; alert when deviation > 15% for 3 contiguous windows. keep noise low.

sam: one more: add an annotation layer on dashboard for deploys + kernel changes + quantization flips. very helpful.

maria: action items: 1) sam to propose event proto and labels (due EOD) 2) jon to mock Grafana panels (tomorrow) 3) eva to define normalization approach and p95/p99 queries (2d) 4) dena to propose alert thresholds (2d). I'll follow up with a short RFC. :spiral_note_pad: 

jon: ack. I'll throw a quick dashboard mock into #dashboards and link here.

sam: drafting proto now. posting shortly.

batch-bot: reminder: microbatching-tuning sync in 1h

maria: thanks all — short and actionable. :thumbsup:
